title: dubautia linearis
intro: Dubautia linearis, commonly known as the Ma'o hau hele, is a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family that is native to Hawaii. This plant has been used in traditional Hawaiian medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Dubautia linearis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, among others. The sesquiterpene lactones in particular have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, making Dubautia linearis a potentially valuable natural remedy for a range of health conditions.
